messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the INC-547 postmortem — I pulled the actions list and filled in a first pass of owners/dates. Need people to confirm or reassign so we can close the loop. TL;DR: infra migration, log retention, canary run, and docs update.

maya: thanks alex. can you paste the list here? easier to confirm inline. :+1:

alex: sure — short version: 
- ACTION A: infra DB migration validation -> proposed owner: sam, due: 2024-11-08
- ACTION B: increase log retention + alert thresholds -> proposed owner: maya, due: 2024-10-30
- ACTION C: canary run of fallback model routing -> proposed owner: jia, due: 2024-11-01
- ACTION D: update runbook + postmortem doc -> proposed owner: oliver, due: 2024-11-05

sam: I can own ACTION A but need infra team help for the migration window. tagging @oliver for approvals and @maya for post-migration alert tuning. ETA 11/8 ok if infra slot booked.

oliver: I can approve but need the migration playbook first. sam can you add a short checklist (downtime, rollback command, monitoring) here?

sam: will add checklist later today. draft snippet: ```rollback: systemctl stop redwood-inference && /opt/redwood/bin/rollback.sh --to-tag inc547-safe```

maya: ACTION B ok for me. I want to change the due date to 11/02 though (need 2 business days before the canary to watch retention effects). Is that ok?

jia: ACTION C — can do the canary but need a compatible model variant staged (low-q quant) and 2 x A100 slot for 4 hours. Can we tie the canary to the migration completion event? if so, plan: smoke tests -> 2-hour canary -> metrics check -> ramp. proposed due 11/03 (one day after the updated retention window).

alex: proposal: sam books migration window targeting 11/08, maya moves B to 11/02, jia moves C to 11/03, oliver completes docs 11/05. That staggers well. Conflicts?

oliver: fine with that. I'll start the runbook template now and share a link by EOD.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-547 action owner check in scheduled in 48 hours. Use `/oncall actions INC-547` to update status.

maya: small ask — can we add a cross-check step for alert noise? last time retention changes caused a spike. I'll add a test plan item to ACTION B: `verify no alert storm for 48h`

sam: noted. also need a DB freeze window dependency from data-team — pinging them separately. if they can't commit, I may need to reschedule.

alex: thanks all. final ask: please update the action tracker (https://redwood.okr/actions/INC-547) with confirmed owner + date by EOD tomorrow. I'll run a follow-up thread if anything changes. :sparkles:

jia: done — commented on the tracker and added resource request for 2x A100.

sam: checklist posted: https://internal/redwood/ops/inc547/migration-checklist.md — added rollback command and monitoring queries.

oliver: draft runbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/inc547-runbook-draft.md — will add screenshots and the postmortem appendix.

alex: perfect. closing this thread for now — reopen if owners change. :wave:
